sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.StoreCode AS storeCode, p.StoreName AS name, p.PortalId AS portalId FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeDomain d ON d.PortalId = p.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalGlobalAttributeValue gav ON gav.PortalId = p.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeGlobalAttribute ga ON ga.GlobalAttributeId = gav.GlobalAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeGlobalEntity ge ON ge.GlobalEntityId = ga.GlobalEntityId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalGlobalAttributeValueLocale gavl ON gavl.PortalGlobalAttributeValueId = gav.PortalGlobalAttributeValueId WHERE d.ApplicationType = @applicationType AND d.IsActive = @domainActive AND ge.EntityName = @globalEntity AND ga.AttributeCode = @attributeCode AND gavl.LocaleId = @localeId AND gavl.AttributeValue = @quoteRequestsEnabled AND p.StoreCode = @store AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.StoreCode = @preferred) GROUP BY p.PortalId, p.StoreCode, p.StoreName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.DomainId) >= @minWebstoreDomains ORDER BY p.PortalId
